principle: Improve memory usefulness over time by retaining what is reusable, summarizing what is bulky, surfacing what is timely, and forgetting what is stale.
guardrails: prefer selective retention over memory hoarding
prefer compressed reusable artifacts over bulky raw history
forget stale or low-value detail rather than accumulating noise
surface memory when it helps action, not just because it exists
rule: Use mission outcomes to improve memory selectivity and compression without turning memory into clutter.
